name: ppt-foreground-cutout-rembg
requiredPlugins: ComfyUI-RMBG or any node exposing RMBG/BRIA/background-removal image matting
description: Remove background from a product/foreground image and save transparent PNG for PPT composition.

2.notes: If your installed plugin uses a different node name, replace RMBG with the available background-removal node. Keep input image and output image ports compatible.

fallback.method: local PNG flood-fill first, cloud image edit only when configured and needed
